data.description: Followed README Configure literally: 'entire enable' + 'setup-refspec'. After that, grep for 'etch' in .entire/.claude/.git/hooks finds NOTHING — the installed Claude Code hooks dispatch to 'entire hooks claude-code ...', never to 'entire-agent-etch'. So real agent sessions are captured by Entire's own engine, not by Etch. README 'Usage' says: 'As an operator you do nothing — once etch is registered, Etch captures every session invisibly.' But the README never gives a working way to REGISTER etch on the version it was tested against: the Entire version note admits 'entire agent add etch' returns 'Unknown agent' on v0.6.3 and that external-agent dispatch 'depends on your Entire version.' Net effect for a naive user: enable, do work, get ZERO refs at refs/etch/sessions/, with no troubleshooting guidance. Even 'make smoke' only proves capture by MANUALLY piping hook-event JSON to the binary (smoke.sh step 4), not by Entire dispatching to etch. Recommendation: README must state plainly that on Entire <= 0.6.3 there is no auto-dispatch, document the exact supported path (which Entire version, or the manual hook-wiring), and stop claiming invisible auto-capture works out of the box.
data.title: No documented working auto-capture path on tested Entire v0.6.3 — README 'Usage' promise is false in practice

data.body: DECISION (operator, 2026-06-06): promoted to Wave 0 as an INVESTIGATION lane, not a docs task. Investigate WHY Entire 0.6.3 never dispatches to entire-agent-etch (plugin discovery? hook registration? config?), determine the real fix — code, config, or documented manual wiring — implement it, then ENABLE DOGFOODING on the Etch repo itself. Every other fix in this run is unverifiable in production until capture actually runs; dogfooding is the project's stated integration test.

COMPLETE — PR #20 open (https://forgejo.stage11.ai/s11/etch/pulls/20).

Root cause was four stacked failures, all fixed: (1) info didn't speak Entire's external-agent protocol v1 → discovery silently skipped etch; (2) the install-side protocol (install-hooks etc.) didn't exist — in Entire's model the plugin wires its own dispatch, and that was the missing link; (3) `entire agent add` lacks discovery on 0.6.3 (Entire-side bug) — `entire enable --agent etch` is the working route and now the documented one; (4) hook handlers only parsed Entire's internal dialect while real Claude Code sends native JSON.

The real-thing gate PASSED twice with real `claude -p` sessions (first auto-captured sessions in project history): refs/etch/sessions/01KTHA6BQ4T3CQJPYSA8EM02VS and 01KTHF5WFDQJ19TN5EA2HYCW61 — model (transcript-derived), prompt, tools, files, native exit reason all captured. Evidence: art_01KTHF89ZGY5QZPBQWBM8WHJB9.

DOGFOODING ENABLEMENT (Orchestrator, post-merge, on the main checkout):
```
cd /Users/atin/Projects/Stage11/code/Etch
make install PREFIX=$HOME/.local        # entire-agent-etch on PATH
entire enable --agent etch --no-github  # wires .claude/settings.json
entire-agent-etch are-hooks-installed   # → {"installed":true}
entire-agent-etch setup-refspec         # sync refs with remote
```

Note: auto-fired code-review hung (75 min, stalled child) → killed, own-reviewer fallback executed per boot protocol (review note art_01KTHF4RJ3VND96XN3C9ZARK1J, verdict PASS).

Master Validator: PR #20 (fix/auto-capture) is mergeable=false on Forgejo. Branch base is 01a2ca4 — predates both merged PRs (#17 redaction ec406c7, #18 repo-root eacd4ed), and it touches the same hook files #18 rewrote (internal/hooks/session_end.go, common.go, session_start.go, tool_use.go, user_prompt_submit.go). Needs a rebase onto current main (eacd4ed) + conflict resolution before auto-merge can proceed. Note repo-root's new internal/capture/repocontext.go likely changes the root-resolution this branch's install/hook code assumes.

Rebased fix/auto-capture onto origin/main (PRs #17/#18/#19 landed under us: redaction, repo-root resolveContext/StateRoot model, refspec rework). Conflicts resolved in internal/hooks/common.go (imports union) and session_end.go (composed: model-backfill + transcript-availability refresh BEFORE main's new fail-loud commitSession path, all on rc.StateRoot). README merged take-both (our Configure/Usage rewrite + main's refspec/second-machine docs). Lessons entries already on main via orchestrator checkpoint — union resolved by rebase. Re-validated: go test ./... green, make build green, make smoke green (all 10 steps). Force-pushed with lease; PR #20 now mergeable:true at 74266fd.
